name: Alibaba Coding Plan Pro

price.note: $50 a month, monthly only. China (Bailian): ¥200 a month, with ¥39.90 for the first month for new subscribers.

reset.rule: A sliding 5-hour window. Each minute, the usage from 5 hours earlier is released.
stipulations: Counts model calls, not tokens. A simple task is about 5 to 10 calls and a complex one 10 to 30 or more.
Every tool on your key shares this window.

reset.rule: Resets Monday 00:00 UTC+8, which is Sunday 16:00 UTC.
stipulations: Everything that counts toward the 5-hour window also counts here.

reset.rule: Resets at 00:00 UTC+8 on your subscription day each month.
stipulations: A subscription runs from purchase to 23:59:59 UTC+8 on the same day next month.
All three limits apply at once. Whichever you hit first stops you.

overage: None. Calls fail until the window resets, and nothing switches to paid use. Under load, requests can also be queued or throttled; a 429 means wait a minute.

how: Three request limits at once: 6,000 per 5 hours, 45,000 per week and 90,000 per month.
Requests are counted per model call, so long prompts cost the same as short ones.
Slots are limited. New slots open daily at 00:00 UTC+8 (international) and 09:30 UTC+8 (China).
ext: Models from other labs: kimi-k2.5, glm-5 and MiniMax-M2.5, alongside qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.6-plus and qwen3.5-plus. Models not on the list are unsupported.
Claude Code: https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic. OpenAI-compatible tools (Qwen Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Kilo CLI): https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1.
Only Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages work. The OpenAI Responses API and Claude Code Agent Teams are not supported.
quirks: Plan keys start with sk-sp-. A normal sk- key or a non-coding base URL bills pay-as-you-go instead. This is the most common cause of surprise charges.
Interactive coding tools only. Scripts, backends, batch jobs, Postman or Dify can get the plan suspended or the key revoked.
One Coding Plan per account. No sharing, no refunds and no downgrades.
The console shows total used and remaining only, with no per-model or token figures.
Lite is no longer sold. Renewals ended 13 Apr 2026 and Lite can't be upgraded to Pro.
The free Qwen Code OAuth tier closed on 15 Apr 2026. Qwen Code now points to this plan or your own API key.
